segments.source: There was once a certain Man, and he was very poor, he had no food, no tobe, nothing but a loin-cloth.
So he arose and went to the King, and said " O Lion, I am weary of life so kill me ; I have no food, I have no tobe, I have nothing but a loin-cloth, my poverty is too much for me."
So the King said " Very well," and he ordered his Attendants to take him and put him to death.
But just as they were about to kill him, another Poor Man, who was quite naked, saw him, and said " I have a favour to ask; when you have killed this Man, give me his loin-cloth."
